text: {"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["pale as a shadow"], "mistranslated": ["u lohul ù chucanob (redemption of the rest/those taken) -> 'redemption of all others' (slightly loose)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["catu Zamahuba (He vanished) — rendered instead as 'see that this word has returned'"], "added": ["who was covered in wounds", "see that this word has returned", "who wrote it", "Believe in the Father"], "mistranslated": ["hunk ꝑ (a handful) -> 'a drop'", "in talanil kikel (my precious blood) -> 'the blood of my coming'", "culhi (remained) -> 'sat up'", "ú yicin (his younger brother) -> 'the priest who had come before'", "ɔibolan ti alakoob (coveted by women) -> 'written upon by your sins'", "la kilob cu tabzechobe (companions who deceived you) -> 'evil things that follow you'", "hach pachalac (very late) -> 'he is very patient'", "Cilich nabzah (holy anointing) -> 'Holy Baptism'", "bin ú Zatez à Zipil (he will forgive your sin) -> 'he will lose your transgression'", "ú tħibete (visited him) -> 'who wrote it'", "tunakab (night) -> 'day'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is a fluent, nearly complete and accurate rendering, while B misreads many key words (brother, vanished, coveted, late, anointing, visit) and garbles large stretches of the narrative."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["noc kixob (crown of thorns) -> 'a garment of thorns'", "ma hakotzil ca chacanacentii (it is no wonder that I appeared to you) -> 'Do not be afraid that I appear to you'", "u ꝑel mehen (his only Son, i.e. the Son of God) -> 'the only Son' (slightly flattened)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the younger brother beginning to admonish him and praying for him", "he departed after speaking (ca tu Zitah)", "the sick man trembling (t hoꝑ ù cilba)", "the sun and moon (kin, U) as created for his service", "awaiting the end of his life (tan úpactic û xotol û kin)"], "added": ["\"If you are a brother who spends your days only thinking of foolish things\"", "\"You are like one who opens your ears to hear\"", "\"He began to heal the sick man.\"", "\"who watches over your work since the day\"", "\"with a very tall stature\"", "\"I am not a poor man\""], "mistranslated": ["narrative about the elder brother -> generic second-person exhortation", "tan û hach okol (weeping bitterly) -> 'while he was very worried'", "Dioz Eſpiritu Santo cu yalic lay tħanɔb (against God the Holy Spirit; then he said these words) -> 'The Holy Spirit says these words to those who have sinned'", "nohtzectabal tumen Dioz ... yail cħaphal (punished by God with a grave illness) -> 'being corrected by God, he felt great pain'", "tu pactah u yocol (he saw [someone] enter) -> 'he happened to enter his room'", "takach pactic y ɔicil ù Uich (stern look, frightening face) -> 'very tall stature and a shining face'", "t hoꝑ ù cilba (began to tremble) -> 'began to heal the sick man'", "ca à hach okte à kebanob (so that you might weep for your sins) -> 'You must truly confess your sins'", "Zatal yole ... ceel y Kilcab (as if senseless, with chills and sweat) -> 'lost in thought, in the coolness and the cold of the night'", "la tu lah ù yahal cab (until day dawned) -> 'When the whole world was awake'", "tu caꝑel akabe (on the second night) -> 'at the beginning of the night'", "noc kixob (crown of thorns) -> 'wounds'", "ma hakotzil (it is no wonder) -> 'I am not a poor man'", "in chiic otzil (my mercy) -> 'the poverty'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is a complete translation with only a few small slips, while B misreads the opening as an exhortation and gets the sense wrong in many places throughout."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["'or water' (uaix ha) in the opening instruction", "the image moving as you move (bai û peec xan)", "'nor were created as we were created and all things' / 'before heaven and earth existed' sense", "'clay' (Kat) as the object of worship", "'it is said' (bin) for the two brothers"], "added": ["\"you see your own reflection clearly, just as you are\"", "\"when you move away, the reflection in the mirror disappears\""], "mistranslated": ["here is an image for you to understand -> \"It is like a mirror prepared for you to answer\"", "the divinity is one, and the Father gave all... -> \"there is only one God, and that is the Father\"", "we cannot do this (we only see our reflection) -> \"you cannot say that our reflection ... is our own substance\"", "whom we say is not begotten -> \"You say not a child\"", "before heaven and earth existed, God the Holy Trinity already was, creator of all -> \"Everything that exists in heaven and on earth, and God himself... is the creator\"", "what was written by Enrique Gran -> \"what happened to Henry Gran\"", "the younger (u chichnile) -> \"One of them\"", "virtues/virtuous conduct (tiblilob) -> \"honors\"", "would not join with (matan u tacbezuba) -> \"did not humble himself\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["it moves too (bai û peec xan) -> \"it stops moving as well\"", "dreams are delusions of what you think about while eating (â hanonexe) -> \"come when we sleep\"", "it cannot be surpassed/equalled because supreme over all (ma uchac û tabli yoklal topzazil) -> \"it cannot deceive because He is supremely clear to all things\""]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Maya closely, including the mirror-or-water image, 'not begotten', the clay idols and 'written by Enrique Gran'. A misreads the opening, the Trinity passage and the closing story of the two brothers."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'bin c yacunteex' (whom we shall love), said of the Holy Spirit", "'u pel' (only) in 'the only Son of God'"], "added": ["\"without any human touch\"", "\"holy\" (in 'very good and holy soul')"], "mistranslated": ["light may enter our understanding (ca inac zazil ti c nateex) -> 'so that you may know the Light'", "this comes about through the teaching you heard -> 'This is what happens when you hear this'", "however many your sins may be, if you turn back (caix bahun upic tanil ua c ualkezicex) -> 'how many times we return to the truth'", "What is the reason, in your thought (Baxi u nucul ta tuculeex) -> 'Consider well in your thoughts'", "they do not want holy light to enter their understanding so they may see -> 'did not want the Holy Light to know and see'", "enemies (ahualob) -> gloss 'lords/demons'", "as soon as He formed it (citaci u pacticloe) -> 'without any human touch'", "the body was formed within Mary's womb -> 'within the womb' attached to the creation of the soul"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Maya closely throughout, while A mistakes the opening question 'Baxi', the clause on forgiving sins, the gloss for ahualob and 'citaci u pacticloe', and drops the line about loving the Holy Spirit."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["anaci ú tħancóoƀ tu zeƀlacil Jesu-Cristo (unless Jesus Christ quickly calls them, as he did for the ruler of the synagogue) -> 'unless they quickly call upon Jesus Christ' (subject and object reversed)", "le mazuƀtalil (sloth/torpor) -> 'shame'", "cà le cuchil cimpahané tu zatahuƀa ú chucáan (the deadened part lost its wholeness) -> 'the deadened flesh corrupted the rest'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["\"that you have\"", "\"in its life\""], "mistranslated": ["tu zeƀlacil (immediately) -> 'In the weakness'", "keƀan talamé (grave sin) -> 'the sin of difficulty'", "ua leyli náapzahàanil (if it is constantly delayed) -> 'that which is attached'", "kaƀet ú ƀizáal heƀic tàan ú hiiltáal (it must be dragged as if pulled) -> 'act like one who is being awakened'", "cú omancilóob le xnokolilóob (the worms teem) -> 'the old things ... remain'", "humpel cheh ƀacilil ti cristiano (a mockery/skeleton of a Christian) -> 'a single state of a Christian'", "ƀahun tipàan olmail (how great the difficulty) -> 'how great is the confusion'", "anaci ú tħancóoƀ tu zeƀlacil Jesu-Cristo (unless Christ quickly calls them) -> 'will their words be in the weakness of Jesus Christ'", "cach téex humpel kaƀ (you broke an arm) -> 'you have given a hand'", "cá leti kaƀ chupi (the arm swelled) -> 'that hand is full'", "ƀahun chucáanil yail ... ƀahun hach olmail ù ɔácal (how much more pain, how difficult the cure) -> 'How much weight is this medicine, and how very confusing is its medicine'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A gives a coherent, mostly accurate rendering with a few small slips, while B misreads many key words (zeƀlacil, kaƀ, olmail, xnokol) and much of it reads as nonsense."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["fragment 'buc' (end of the word for garment) at the start of the page", "'u noh celembal' (his great youthful form) is reduced to 'very beautiful'"], "added": ["\"descended upon him\""], "mistranslated": ["arrived at the base/side of the sick man (tu chun) -> 'arrived at the head of the sick man'", "his great mercy (u yah ɔaiatzilich) -> 'its great brilliance'", "come to visit a sufferer full of misery like me -> 'come to help me in my suffering, and with such great whiteness'", "he answered him -> 'He answered me'", "with them I have one nature and power (hun lail y yuchucil) -> 'I am with them, and it is possible'", "weeping sinner (ah okol keban) -> 'the sick man'", "as though he had come out of hell -> 'how he would leave for Metnal'", "can the door of heaven be entered by one whose time was fixed by Father and Son for hell? -> 'may it be that I reach the height of heaven ... for the sake of the underworld'", "can these few tears turn away that judgment to unending fires? -> 'may it be that it changes this cut time into the fire that has no end'", "do not doubt the salvation of your soul -> 'you who desire the salvation of your soul'", "turns back the face/anger and sentence, even though very fearful -> 'turns back the face ... and it is very fearful'", "go and set in order what you have in your house -> 'go and tell what you have said in your house'", "the Father took the likeness of an old man -> 'took a human body'", "before heaven and earth existed -> 'there is no heaven and earth without them'", "and they are not many (maix pimobi) -> 'they are not thick'", "whatever is taught to you -> 'whatever you worship'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "B renders the Maya accurately and completely throughout, while A misreads many key phrases (mercy, nature and power, the escape from hell, the old man's likeness, 'not many') and garbles the sinner's plea."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the ruler/elder figure ('ah nucté') whose love for his daughter is the point of the comparison"], "added": ["\"in the haste of your hearts\""], "mistranslated": ["for grievous sins promptly -> in the suffering of sin, in the haste of your hearts", "that love which the ruler had for his daughter, when she suddenly died -> that he who answers calls to his children, and who suddenly died", "we would see many wonderful restorations to life (hakoƀilóob) -> we see many sick people who are resurrected", "take your power, stretch forth your hand over those dead in sin -> take away the weight of the sins of those who have died", "all of them will live for your glory -> all those who go to live for your glory", "the words deserve very earnest attention (nahmatic ... pelelil ɔá uol) -> they recognize a very great fear of the heart", "his words will not be set aside as if spoken to the wind -> he does not go to have his words blocked as if they were spoken to the wind"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "B renders the Gospel comparison with the ruler and his daughter, the prayer and the sermon opening accurately, while A garbles several key clauses, including the ruler's love for his daughter, the prayer for God's power over the dead in sin, and the call for earnest attention."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["luƀul iix likil tu zeƀlacil lay yáaƀ cóomil emá luƀul... (falling and rising promptly is that short lapse, rather than falling and choosing to stay lying in the mud) -> rendered loosely but in the right sense; minor freedom of phrasing", "humpel zalcunah cá cú cħiczic ù chucáanil (an offence that completes its fullness) -> 'an injury that fills the measure of guilt', a slight interpretive expansion"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["you do not need to delay", "it is the ability to exist before one's own eyes in the place of the fall"], "mistranslated": ["cá ta patahéex ù manel yáab kinil (you let many days pass) -> 'you do not hasten to pass many days'", "tu zeƀlacil (promptly, at once) -> 'with sincerity' (repeatedly)", "utzilil iix ɔoyanil, emá chichpolal (weakness, not obstinacy) -> 'very true goodness and humility, not arrogance'", "hach mukanil hi tuntah (violence of temptation) -> 'true humility of repentance'", "lay yáaƀ cóomil (a brief stumble) -> 'that great weight'", "ten ƀin cħehnacen ti á uotzilil (I will laugh at your misery) -> 'I am going to be ashamed of your misery'", "c tħilicƀaéex ti le ú kahualil Dios (we stay away from God's presence) -> 'we call you to the call of God'", "ú chucáanil mà nahmatic c menticƀaéex (so much more unworthy we make ourselves) -> 'the entirety that we do not need to make ourselves like that'", "ƀahunóob ticħóob (so many hands held out) -> 'the other things that we do'", "zalcunah (offence/injury) -> 'justification'", "xmá olil iix makolal (coldness and sloth) -> 'without heart and with arrogance'", "tulacalóob chunilóob (all these reasons) -> 'all the beginnings'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A gives a coherent and largely accurate rendering of the sermon's argument, while B misreads many key terms (zeƀlacil, zalcunah, cħehnacen, tuntah) and is often unintelligible."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["for your sake he suffered many sufferings"], "mistranslated": ["one who depicts and explains in doctrine -> \"the person who digs up the root and explains it\"", "the soul (uol) is badly terrified and trembles -> \"the heart is truly fixed and is being searched\"", "the blood runs cold (xibil u kikel) -> \"the blood is being shed\"", "great affliction (mummiail) -> \"great mystery\"", "whether that day of sorrow has come or not -> \"a matter of haste, or if it is not a matter of the end of days\"", "he punishes us (tzecultóon) with the many afflictions that have come -> \"for your sake he suffered many sufferings\"", "how Christians behave in the churches -> \"many Christians who serve in the temples\"", "O Mother of God -> \"You, or the Mother of God\"", "importance (kananil) -> \"danger\"", "ask your child for the gifts of grace -> \"help me as I ask to speak of the helps of grace\"", "necessary (kanáan) -> \"precious\"", "how perfect are his words -> \"or the fullness of his words\"", "gentle and sweet (chahucil) words -> \"sweetness and the bitterness\"", "the Forgiver of sins (Ahzáat-zah zipil) -> \"the Teacher who rebukes your sins\"", "setting apart all his perfections -> \"dividing all his fullness\"", "in his writing (ɔilib) -> \"for his own\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["you flee (puɔcóonéx) -> \"let us flee\"", "beyond reckoning/repetition (xmá ú capelcuntáal) -> \"beyond doubt\" (minor)", "whom you do not take care to know -> \"whom we do not first recognize\" (slight)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B gives a coherent, mostly accurate version of the whole page; A garbles many key senses (punishment, sweetness, Forgiver of sins, the address to Mary) and leaves the first paragraph inside a meta tag."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["those who look upon us with malice"], "mistranslated": ["who keeps it completely (tu tululil cu tacuntic) -> who brings all these things to mind", "one who is chaste (coycab) in words, deeds, thoughts -> one who consents to these words, deeds, and thoughts", "if one strives to drive them away (ɔanuculintic u nachcunticoob) -> if one consents to them or dwells upon them", "rather one gains merit if one removes them (Mayli cu nahaltic) -> Yes, one incurs guilt if one does not cast away", "or who takes pleasure in them willingly -> by speaking of them directs their heart toward them", "remain chaste (laytal h coycabil) -> remain in this state of grace", "prayer (Okoltba) -> repentance", "our devotions/mortifications (c meyahtbaoob) -> our good works", "bad conduct/shamelessness, glances and conversations inclined to evil -> the shameless, those who look with malice, those who speak evil words", "the seventh commandment (u uucpel) -> the seven commandments", "nor keeps what belongs to another against its owner's will -> nor desires it... not granted to them by their master", "who sins against it (zipilti) -> who lies"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["remove the sinful thoughts (nuculoob keban) -> removes the occasions of sin", "keeps (yanti) -> keeps; desires (yoltic) rendered fine, but 'má tu ciboltic' (does not will) -> against the will — acceptable; slight looseness in 'with full consent' for 'u yalahul'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B gets the catechism on chastity and the seventh commandment right throughout. A misreads most of the key terms (coycab, Mayli cu nahaltic, uucpel, zipilti), so its answers have the wrong meaning."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["yuntzilóob / palilóob (fathers/lords and children, i.e. parents and children in this sequence of household duties) -> 'masters and servants' (a possible reading of the words, but probably not the sense here)", "palilóob y le yumtzilóob (children toward parents) -> 'servants toward their masters'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'ti laóobé' is kept only loosely; 'Hebic y le ú mehentzilóob Diosé' (as God is toward His children) loses the sense of God's relation to them"], "added": ["'when it is necessary'"], "mistranslated": ["Hebic y le ú mehentzilóob Diosé (as God with His children) -> 'As the children of God'", "báax cú uetħic chucanil ... má cimzah (what it fully forbids, namely not killing) -> 'what does it mean to not kill'", "ú loxic, ú nacuntic, cú zalcunahtic (strikes, injures, mistreats) -> 'insults, strikes, mocks'", "ti ú ah pocħil má tu záat zicé (does not forgive the one who offended him) -> 'does not help when it is necessary'", "kazil ɔilib (bad example, i.e. scandal) -> 'bad advice'", "le iglesia y Cristo (the Church and Christ) -> 'as the Church is to Christ' (small shift)"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A gets the fifth-commandment section right, including not forgiving an offender and bad example, and is off only on the parents/children pair; B gets several key points wrong."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ú ɔá zipil 'to whom he gives sin / whom he leads to sin' -> 'whereby occasions of sin arise' (loose)", "napzah uaiix tá kaholticéex -> 'serve to correct what you already recognize' (sense uncertain, somewhat interpretive)", "hach nanacilóob -> 'exceedingly prevalent' (possibly 'very serious/burdensome')"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ah ƀolóob 'sellers' (who were there so pilgrims could buy and sacrifice)", "ú ticħilóob / ú ticħóob 'to offer/sacrifice' rendered as keeping, so the sacrificial purpose is lost"], "added": ["\"while they were fleeing\"", "\"you who are called\""], "mistranslated": ["tu meyhultah 'what he did' -> 'what the Lord found'", "ú ticħilóob 'to be offered in sacrifice' -> 'brought in and kept there'", "In heláancuntah ... Ahzáat-zahuléex 'how our Savior changed this' -> 'He changed his appearance'", "kaƀcheóob 'cords/whip' -> 'wooden benches'", "ƀáaltacóoba iix ti loxóob iix ni yocóob 'with blows and kicks' -> 'threw their tables and their feet'", "tàan ú acam iix tàan ú tzéecticóob 'crying out and rebuking them' -> 'while they were fleeing and while they were shouting'", "Ahzáat-zah zipiléex ... (Christ acted thus because irreverence is grave) -> 'great sin for you, you who are called ... sinners'", "cú káatic ... nucul yáaƀ mucul 'requires much reserve' -> 'I ask for that which is very hidden'", "Má á ɔáic á uoléex ti Dios 'not giving your hearts' -> 'will' (minor)"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the sermon's account of the temple cleansing and its application closely, while B misreads several key actions (whip, kicks, rebuking) and gets the logic of the second paragraph wrong."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["'cú zalmanelóob' (their neighbours / others around them) is not clearly rendered"], "added": ["Who is the one", "by paying for what they have broken or damaged"], "mistranslated": ["statement: the one who does serious harm to another or causes another to do it -> turned into a question 'Who is the one who does something evil...?'", "is it enough for the one who stole or did harm to confess his sin? -> 'Is it the one who causes or performs evil who must pay for the sin?'", "No, unless he repays what he owes its owner as soon as he can -> 'Yes, by paying for what they have broken or damaged'", "and if he has no means to do it? -> 'Is it the one who has no power to do what they intend?'", "he must intend to do it when he can, as far as he is able -> 'They are held accountable just as if they had done it, in every way'", "the one who does not think ill of others without good reason -> 'does not spread evil about others'", "who sins against it? (zipiltic) -> 'Who is the one who lies?'", "takes away a good reputation unjustly (lukzic pectzil) -> 'removes the truth without justice'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the catechism's questions and answers closely and correctly, while B gets the restitution exchange badly wrong (including 'Yes' where the source says 'No') and misreads several key terms."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["'Ná' (Mother) in the heading and in the first question about the Holy Mother Church", "'nohpolil' (supreme/head): the Church is governed by the supreme bishop, not just a bishop"], "added": ["\"or to desire another's property\"", "\"for the poor and the wealthy alike may walk in the path of righteousness\"", "\"often associated with sin\""], "mistranslated": ["is it sin to desire wealth unless it is for a good end -> is it a sin to desire wealth or another's property through good and honest means", "No, only when they are desired dishonestly, not in their proper way, and greedily -> No, for the poor and the wealthy alike may walk in the path of righteousness", "why do the commandments forbid lustful desires and desires for wealth -> why are the poor and the wealthy often associated with sin", "ruled by the supreme bishop (the Pope) -> led by the bishop who oversees it"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["'tuba ti' / 'iix taɔmanzahóob' (and with excess/greed) is rendered loosely as 'through dishonest means'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B correctly renders the tenth-commandment questions on wealth and lust, and the supreme bishop (Pope), while A invents content about the poor and the wealthy and misreads the first two exchanges."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["since Mass has been spoken of, tell me (Bahun ti ú yabal misa, áalten) -> \"How many masses are there\"", "a sacrifice made of Christ -> \"performed for Christ\" (ambiguous slip)", "to the Infinite Lord (h maxulunté Yum) -> \"To God the Father\"", "and to which persons especially (ti máacóob cú chuniltic) -> \"And for those who initiate them?\"", "those who offer them (cú ticħilóob) -> \"attended\"", "those for whom they are said (cú yalabalóob) -> \"by whom they are requested\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["we owe all reverence/obedience (tulul tzic) -> \"supreme reverence\" (minor)", "give thanks and love -> \"thanks in return of love\" (slightly forced)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the catechism's sense closely (Mass having been mentioned, which persons especially, those who offer them), while A misreads several questions and answers."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["kij paru ꜭhij ('ourselves, from its ...') -> 'from the burning heat' (likely a guess)", "ꜭhixibalbal ('of Xibalba') is put at the end of the list as 'in Xibalba', which blurs the phrasing a little", "marayil ('greatness/abyss') -> 'great' (acceptable but loose)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ꜭhirughumumibal 'with groaning' as a distinct item"], "added": ["...the means of suffering, the means of desire, let it be so, because of the payment for his sins in Purgatory,", "he who will come to the place of death here"], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhioꜫeh 'with weeping' -> 'Listen'", "ꜭhirughumumibal 'with groaning' -> 'Listen to the place of his hearing'", "ꜭhiruꜫatatibal ka gux 'with the breaking of our heart' -> 'the place of his seeing, our heart'", "ti katoh beh 'so that we may pay it' -> 'how we walk the path'", "ka ('our') -> 'your' throughout the confession passage", "ti ka col beh kij 'we free ourselves' -> 'you must save your path upon your face'", "kiꜯih 'it is true' -> 'it is written'", "ha ru camah ka Confesion 'this is the work of our confession' -> 'he who takes up his Confesion'", "ha ta maqui kobe vi 'that we will not go' -> 'he who does not enter'", "ti hal bex, ti gex 'it is changed, it is exchanged' -> 'he who changes his path'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A gets the penitential argument about weeping, contrition, confession, penance and commuting eternal punishment into lesser suffering basically right, while B misreads key verbs as 'listen' and 'path' and adds made-up text from a previous page."}
